messages.content: I’m ready to do the Philadelphia flights. Please verify the fare details and compare the realistic Monday and Thursday choices before you charge anything.

I found two nonstop Monday options from DFW to PHL. The 4:45 p.m. departure arrives at 8:54 p.m.; Main Cabin is $278 outbound. The 6:20 p.m. departure arrives at 10:29 p.m.; Basic Economy is $219 outbound or Main Cabin is $264. Main Cabin on either flight is nonrefundable but can be changed without a change fee, with any fare difference due; cancellation produces a one-year airline credit. Basic Economy cannot be changed and only yields a credit after a $99 cancellation charge.
What does that do to the full round trip? I will have one carry-on and may check one suitcase.

For Thursday, the 4:35 p.m. nonstop arrives DFW at 7:21 p.m. and costs $196 in Basic Economy or $241 in Main Cabin. The 7:25 p.m. nonstop arrives at 10:13 p.m. and costs $248 in Main Cabin. Combining Main Cabin both ways gives these totals before a checked bag: $519 for the 4:45 Monday and 4:35 Thursday pair, $526 for 4:45 Monday and 7:25 Thursday, or $512 for 6:20 Monday and 7:25 Thursday. A carry-on and personal item are included. One checked suitcase costs $40 each way, making those totals $599, $606, and $592 respectively.
The Thursday program ends at 3:00. Is the 4:35 even workable if my suitcase is at the hotel near the convention center?

It is technically possible but not practical. You would need to leave almost immediately, retrieve the suitcase, and use a car directly to PHL. Even with light traffic, you would likely reach the terminal around 3:50, only 45 minutes before departure and close to the checked-bag cutoff. The 7:25 flight allows time to collect the bag and take the Airport Line or a car, with a target airport arrival around 5:30.
Agreed. Drop the 4:35. Between the Monday flights, is arriving at 10:29 going to create a problem for the optional briefing Tuesday morning?

It should not affect the briefing itself, but it makes Monday less forgiving. Allowing time to deplane and travel into Center City, you would probably reach the hotel between 11:15 and 11:40 p.m. The 4:45 flight should put you there around 9:40. It also has slightly better protection if the flight is delayed, since there is more evening left to recover or be reaccommodated.
Then the extra $14 is worth it. Use the 4:45 Monday and 7:25 Thursday, both Main Cabin. Confirm the exact total once more, including the possible suitcase.

The airfare is $526 round trip, including taxes and fees. If you check one suitcase in each direction, baggage adds $80, for a maximum flight cost of $606. The bag fees are paid when you check in and are not part of today’s charge. Both segments permit changes without a change fee, subject to fare difference, and cancellation before departure returns the ticket value as an airline credit valid for one year from issuance. Neither segment is refundable to the original payment method.
Can I choose seats now, and are there any extra charges for ordinary seats?

Yes. Standard seats are included with these Main Cabin fares. On Monday, 17C aisle and 18A window are available. On Thursday, 19D aisle and 20F window are available. Extra-legroom and preferred rows cost more.
Take 17C Monday and 19D Thursday. Those standard seats are fine. Go ahead and purchase with the traveler and card information on file.

Before I submit: the purchase is one passenger, DFW to PHL nonstop Monday, November 3, departing 4:45 p.m. and arriving 8:54 p.m., then PHL to DFW nonstop Thursday, November 6, departing 7:25 p.m. and arriving 10:13 p.m. Both are Main Cabin, with seats 17C and 19D. The card will be charged $526 now; a checked suitcase would add $40 at each airport. Shall I complete it?

The flights are ticketed for $526 under confirmation PHL6N8. Monday’s nonstop departs DFW at 4:45 p.m., arrives PHL at 8:54 p.m., and seat 17C is confirmed. Thursday’s nonstop departs PHL at 7:25 p.m., arrives DFW at 10:13 p.m., and seat 19D is confirmed. One carry-on and one personal item are included; a checked suitcase is $40 each way if used. The ticket is nonrefundable, but it can be changed without a change fee or canceled before departure for a one-year airline credit. The hotel remains unbooked, so the next step is to confirm its cancellation penalty and Thursday luggage storage before reserving the three nights.
